reviews.text: Smooth applicator and soft formula. Lips feel slightly plumper after use. The color comes out really well too. Downside is I don't feel like it lasts too long
reviews.zh: 塗抹頭滑順，質地柔軟。搽完之後嘴唇感覺有少少飽滿。顯色都好出色。缺點係我覺得唔算好持久。

reviews.text: Gives my lips a soft, plump look without feeling sticky. Perfect for everyday use when I want a natural glossy finish.
reviews.zh: 畀到我嘴唇柔軟又飽滿嘅感覺，又唔會黐笠笠。想要自然水光妝效嘅日常用就啱晒。

reviews.text: A very comfortable lip product that adds a subtle plumping effect and a glossy finish. It makes lips look fuller and smoother without any strong tingling. Great for everyday use when you want hydrated, polished lips.
reviews.zh: 好舒服嘅唇部產品，有微微豐唇效果同水光妝效。令到嘴唇睇落更飽滿更滑，唔會有強烈刺痛感。想要水潤又精緻嘅唇妝，日常用一流。

reviews.text: Pretty colour but the minty taste is so chemically. There’s no plumping effect despite the strong minty taste.
reviews.zh: 顏色靚，但薄荷味好化學。薄荷味好重但完全冇豐唇效果。

reviews.text: A pretty colour that would suit summer muted toned people. Bit darkish for myself but still pretty glow and great scent
reviews.zh: 顏色靚，適合夏天啲低調調嘅人。對我嚟講有少少深，不過光澤同香味都依然好正。

reviews.text: Color met expectations. I wanted a cool toned muted stick gloss. My lips peel and crack after most products but I have yet to have that reaction with wearing this. The texture reminds me of the makeup by Mario lip serum balm/stick. I would buy another one if there was another sale for sure.
reviews.zh: 顏色符合期望。我想要冷調低調嘅唇釉筆。大部分產品都會令我嘴唇甩皮爆拆，但用呢支就未試過有呢個情況。質地令我諗起 makeup by Mario 嘅 lip serum balm/stick。如果再特價我一定會再買多支。

reviews.text: when it says volumizing, it is volumizing. I love the shade as well. I got the 02 Lenient, very pretty coral, perfect for spring and summer. It almost like my lip colour. Doesn't clump up at all.
reviews.zh: 話豐唇就真係豐唇。我都好鍾意呢隻色號。我買咗 02 Lenient，好靚嘅珊瑚色，春天同夏天用一流。幾乎同我唇色一樣。完全唔會結成一撻撻。

reviews.text: reminds me of hourglass. color is very pretty. It's a gloss so it doesn't stay on very long but I still love how it goes on your lip and how glossy it is. Color is little darker than it is on the site.
reviews.zh: 令我諗起 hourglass。顏色好靚。始終係唇彩，所以唔算好持久，不過我都好鍾意佢搽上嘴嘅感覺同水潤光澤。顏色比起網站上睇到有少少深。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
